invariants: A product may have exactly one canonical department.
A product may have exactly one canonical category when status is PASS or REMAP.
Marketing words such as gift, trending, summer and Christmas never override core product identity.
Shelf density can never change product classification.
BOOM Stylist may rank within an eligible shelf but may not change taxonomy.
Ambiguous or conflicting identities go to TAXONOMY_REVIEW rather than first-match routing.
Restricted or unsafe product classes are blocked before merchandising.
